claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if executed agreements do not appear in subsequent statutory filings as backlog, contract liabilities or disclosed capacity reservations; upgrade only after a named customer or statutory filing corroborates the commitment.
claims.statement: Soitec management states that the company is entering more than ten multi-year wafer-supply and capacity-reservation agreements. Customers pay deposits in installments; deposits are refundable if contracted volumes are met and forfeited otherwise. This is customer-to-Soitec costly commitment, but all counterparties remain unnamed and the statement is not customer-corroborated.
